title: Mini Dew Blush™ Trio Gift Set

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, oilFree, squalane, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean + Planet Aware✓ Fragrance Free✓ Best for Dry, Combo, Normal Skin✓ Liquid Formula✓ Without Silicones✓ Radiant Finish
What it is: A bestselling gift set of three mini liquid cream blushes, featuring limited-edition shade Cherie, for a dewy wash of color.

Ingredient Callouts: These products are vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This creamy formula blends seamlessly for a dewy wash of color that’s never patchy or streaky. The chunky doe foot makes targeted application easy and allows you to build shades to your desired level. Dew Blush™ is fragrance-free, safe for sensitive skin, and dermatologist-tested.

This Set Contains:
- 3 x 0.2 oz/ 5.9 mL Mini Dew Blush™ in Cherie (red), Chilly (mauve), Lady (nude mauve)

Clean + Planet Aware at Sephora
Products formulated without certain ing
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use the chubby doe-foot to dab one to two dots of Dew Blush™ onto each cheek.
-For deeper color, add more as desired.
-Blend out with fingertips onto apples of cheeks, cheekbones, or anywhere else you want a dewy wash of color.
Ingredients+
Isocetyl Stearoyl Stearate, Glycerin, Tribehenin, Aqua/Water/Eau, Glyceryl Stearate, Sambucus Nigra Fruit Extract, Mica, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Silica, Morus Alba Leaf Extract, Symphytum Officinale Leaf Extract, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Root Extract. [+/- May Contain/Peut Contenir: Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Red 7 (Ci 15850), Red 22 (Ci 45380), Red 27 Lake (Ci 45410), Ferric Ferrocyanide (Ci 77510)].
The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
